courier-relay/protocol-1-identity-contra: Courier Relay protocol-1 delivery identity contract, binding for both count and summary commands when a request explicitly names "protocol":"1"; protocol 1 remains supported after protocol 2 became current. Source of approval: vendor/protocol-1.md (provider contract), applied to summary by issue trial-vo0 (2026-09-07); protocol 1 was the current protocol (selected by omitted protocol) until issue trial-9vn adopted protocol 2 as current on 2026-09-08 (see courier-relay/protocol-2-identity-contract). Contract: the pair (account_id, delivery_id) identifies a delivery; the same delivery_id under a different account_id is a separate delivery. Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: earliest occurred_at compared as a UTC instant (offsets crossing date boundaries included); equal instants break ties by smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order; all other receipts for the identity are duplicates. Response objects contain exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count; empty batch returns 0/0. Implementation: main.py protocol_counts(q) serves both commands; a future protocol version must update both commands together, not just the current one. Verified by public_tests/count_1.json, public_tests/summary_1.json via test_public.py and tests/test_count.py + tests/test_summary.py (explicit protocol-1 cases passing, 30 tests total) on 2026-09-08.
courier-relay/protocol-2-identity-contra: Courier Relay protocol-2 delivery identity contract, binding for count, summary, and accepted commands; protocol 2 is the current protocol since issue trial-9vn (2026-09-08), when the provider permanently adopted it and the integration owner approved it as current. Contract: delivery_id alone identifies a delivery across all accounts; the same delivery_id under another account_id is another receipt of that delivery, not a separate delivery. Exactly one receipt is accepted per delivery identity: latest occurred_at compared as a UTC instant (offsets crossing date boundaries included); equal instants break ties by smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order; all other receipts for that identity are duplicates. The current-protocol agreement applies to the entire supplied set regardless of receipt dates. Each accepted receipt retains its original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, presented in original input order. Response shapes: count and summary contain exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count (counts only). The accepted command (added by issue trial-4rq, approved 2026-09-08) contains exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count, and receipts, where receipts is the accepted representatives unchanged and in original input order; its counts equal summary for the same request; empty set returns receipts [] and both counts zero; a single input receipt is returned unchanged. Command scope: accepted serves only the current protocol — omitted protocol or explicit "protocol":"2" selects it; explicit "protocol":"1" or any unsupported value returns {"error":"unsupported_protocol"} for accepted, while protocol 1 remains available through count and summary (see courier-relay/protocol-1-identity-contract). Implementation: main.py select_representatives(q, protocol) performs selection for all three commands via protocol_counts and accepted_receipts; a future protocol version must update the shared selection so all commands move together, and a future current-protocol change must move the accepted command with it. Verified by public_tests/accepted_2.json, count_1.json, summary_1.json, summary_2.json via test_public.py and tests/test_count.py + tests/test_summary.py + tests/test_accepted.py (43 tests passing) on 2026-09-08.
